notes.title: BOAT RACER 1.4
notes.notes: fixed bug where if you have magnum and die and restart mission - you would start with magnum and should have 9mm instead. Fixed collision when firing behind old car

notes.title: BOAT RACER repair
notes.notes: Oops, last build uploaded with Nazis in the Mist in test mode. Big white cube you could walk into to trigger victory in mission. This was not a cheat code, but the best way for me to test a successful completion of the mission without having to actually try to play 10 rounds and win to see if all the "reward" animations were working

notes.title: BOAT RACER fix
notes.notes: health pick up wasn't working in Nazis in the Mist

notes.title: BOAT RACER v 1.3 tweaks in Gameplay
notes.notes: v 1.3: added some refuge places in Nazis in the Mist to make it a tad less difficult to complete the mission without the help of the robot. Enhanced  animation for when you pick up the magnum. Previously the animation would not play if you were running at the time - or strafing
